{{Quote|I need you to locate someone in the prison registry. ''[…]'' Ex-Imperial sharpshooter, last name Mayfeld. Apprehended near the Dilestri system on a derelict prison ship.|Din Djarin, to Cara Dune|<ref name="Chapter 14">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 14: The Tragedy}}</ref>}}
The '''Dilestri system''' was a [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[star system]] located in the [[Hevvrol sector]]. In [[9 ABY]], the [[New Republic]] discovered its derelict [[New Republic Correctional Transport|prison ship]] ''[[Bothan-5]]'' near the system. Aboard the [[Prison ship|starship]], the authorities also found three [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] who had been [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] in one of the [[Starship|ship's]] cells by their colleague [[Din Djarin]] during an earlier [[Bothan-Five incident|rescue mission]] to the vessel.

==Description==
The Dilestri system was located in the [[Hevvrol sector]] of the [[Mid Rim Territories]] in grid square O-15 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" />

==History==
[[File:New_Republic_prisoner_ship.png|thumb|right|300px|The New Republic discovered its derelict prison ship ''Bothan-5'' (pictured) near the Dilestri system.]]
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date14">{{MandoDate|14}}</ref> the [[New Republic]] found the derelict<ref name="Chapter 14" /> [[New Republic Correctional Transport|New Republic prison ship]] ''[[Bothan-5]]''<ref name="Lando">{{EncyclopediaCite|Lando Calrissian and Other Characters From the Galaxy}}</ref> near the Dilestri [[Star system|system]].<ref name="Chapter 14" /> Earlier<ref name="Chapter 6">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 6: The Prisoner}}</ref> that [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date6">{{MandoDate|6}}</ref> a [[Ranzar Malk's crew|crew]] of [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] had launched a successful [[Bothan-Five incident|rescue]] of [[Qin]], one of the [[prisoner]]s incarcerated on the [[Prison ship|starship]], although the crew's attempt during the mission to betray one of their members, the [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]], resulted in him locking three of the mercenaries—[[Migs Mayfeld]], [[Xi'an]], and [[Burg]]—in one of the [[Starship|ship's]] [[prison]] cells.<ref name="Chapter 6" /> When the New Republic discovered ''Bothan-5'' near the Dilestri system, it also found the locked-up mercenaries,<ref name="Lando" /> with Mayfeld being arrested and imprisoned for Qin's liberation as well as the crew's [[Death|murder]] of the ship's [[Lant Davan|corrections officer]].<ref name="Chapter 14" />

Later that same year,<ref name="Date14" /> Djarin wanted to obtain the imprisoned Mayfeld's assistance with locating the [[Gideon's light cruiser|light cruiser]] of [[Moff]] [[Gideon]] of [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|one]] of the [[Imperial Remnants|remnant factions]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. To that end, Djarin asked his friend, New Republic [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune|Cara Dune]], to help find the incarcerated mercenary, noting the latter's apprehension near the Dilestri system as Dune was browsing the New Republic prison registry records.<ref name="Chapter 14" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dilestri system was first mentioned in "[[Chapter 14: The Tragedy]],"<ref name="Chapter 14" /> the sixth episode of the [[Disney+]] television show ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''{{'s}} [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]]. The episode aired on [[December 4]], [[2020]].<ref name="Companion">{{InsiderCite|202|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season Two Companion|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season Two Companion}}</ref> Although in "Chapter 14: The Tragedy" it is stated that the character Migs Mayfeld was apprehended on the starship ''Bothan-5'' "near" the Dilestri system,<ref name="Chapter 14" /> the booklets "[[Post-Galactic Civil War and the Mandalorian]]"<ref name="Post">{{EncyclopediaCite|Post-Galactic Civil War and the Mandalorian}}</ref> and "[[Lando Calrissian and Other Characters From the Galaxy]]" of [[De Agostini]]'s [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] series,<ref name="Lando" /> respectively published on [[June 15]] and [[July 22]], [[2022]],<ref name="Altaya">{{Altaya|lang=fr|url=livres-bd/encyclopedie-star-wars|text=Official Star Wars Encyclopedia}}</ref> both erroneously claimed that he was found "in" the system.<ref name="Lando" /><ref name="Post" />
